messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Financial Transactions" as it appears in the following examples.
['After this period, the required sum will be taken from your default payment option and the signup will be activated.', 'OUR SECURITY DEPARTMENT HAVE NOTICED AN ILLEGAL MONEY TRANSFER FROM your HSBC internet banking account.', 'We ask for your support financially and otherwise.remember your little contribution will go along way to change their situation.', 'We are unable to process this payment to your account as your details has not been updated to our new database', 'Make payments or send money.', 'You have an incoming payment selected for your account.', 'We have decided to give you 20%of the fund for your involvement, 10% will be for expenses and 70%is for my colleagues and me,', 'This e-mail has been sent to you by BT Internet to inform you that we were unable to process your most recent payment of bill.', "The charge for this order will appear on your credit card statement from the merchant 'AMZN Payment Services.'"]

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
